_nguon: EN-ALL GĐ 3d vòng 4 — đoạn hỗ trợ MỀM đặt trên câu trả lời khi câu hỏi có một tín hiệu buồn yếu (luangiai/an_toan.ho_tro_mem_en). Số đường dây kiểm lại 2026-11-11: 988 (Mỹ, gọi / nhắn), Samaritans 116 123 (Anh, Ireland), SOS 1767 (Singapore, 24 giờ), Befrienders KL 03-7627 2929 (Malaysia), NCMH 1553 (Philippines), findahelpline.com (nơi khác).
an_toan_mem.ho_tro: It sounds like something heavy has been sitting with you lately. Your question is answered below, and you don't have to carry the rest alone: talking to someone you trust helps, and free, confidential lines are open — call or text 988 in the US, Samaritans 116 123 in the UK and Ireland, SOS 1767 in Singapore, Befrienders 03-7627 2929 in Malaysia, 1553 in the Philippines, or find a line near you at findahelpline.com. If you ever feel you might hurt yourself, call your local emergency number.
